name: Bokura no Kankin Shinsatsushitsu ~Shimai Torikaekko Choukyou~
original_name: ぼくらの監禁診察室～姉妹とりかえっこ調教～
source:
The protagonist, Hasumi Yuuto, is a high school student who, while his parents, who work as obstetricians, are away from home, plots with his best friend, Daiki, to swap their sisters, Ai and Misaki, and begin a rape game in the examination room.
Betrayed by their own families and sacrificed for a sexually insane game, what fate awaits Ai and Misaki...?!
translation:
主人公莲见悠斗是一名高中生，当他的父母是产科医生时，他离家出走，他和他最好的朋友大树密谋交换他们的姐妹爱和美咲，并在检查室开始了强奸游戏。
被自己的家人背叛，为了性疯狂的游戏而牺牲，爱和美咲的命运会怎样……？！
